prior_outcome_exposure: Posterior exploratory ecological contrast: whole-landscape and per-year source photo night/day ORs were already observed in PR267. Selected pairs are ecological examples; NOT an independent hypothesis confirmation. All four predeclared pairs and unfavorable/undefined outcomes must be reported.

source_lock.original_rule: Source-local DateTime, original exact SiteID, source UTM geometry transformed privately, 1-minute photoperiod caliper at same pre-frozen Dec-solstice mirror dates, >=20 pre-outcome pair camera-year calendar support, 30-minute same site/taxon separation, >=0.8 vote certainty, all original taxa maintained

question: Does the season-associated change in the share of NIGHT camera records relative to ALL daylight differ between a predator and a candidate prey species at the same physical source camera and same solstice-year cycle, and does it replicate across camera sites?

pair_order_fixed.interpretation: spotted hyena versus zebra; predator and possible prey, not photographed hunting evidence
female lion versus wildebeest; predator-prey example, lion and early-year wildebeest support can be sparse
two large herbivores in overlapping landscape, ecological negative-context comparison but not a randomized control
two sympatric carnivores, not necessarily competitors in each local event

units.base: physical camera SiteID × 2010/2011/2012 December-solstice cycle, never camera photos as independent sites
units.eligibility: same site-cycle has at least ONE retained source PHOTO record from BOTH taxa in BOTH annual branches; all sites failing this are counted as unsupported, never silently omitted
units.night: outside computed sunrise-to-sunset, includes extra-daylight civil twilight
units.main_descriptor: D_i = (night fraction of focal in falling - night fraction of comparison in falling) - (night fraction of focal in rising - night fraction of comparison in rising), on co-recorded camera site-cycle support. D ∈[-2,2].
units.primary_aggregation: For each physical camera ID, arithmetic average D across its eligible solstice cycles. Then average equally over distinct physical cameras (camera-equal).
secondary_aggregations: Equal weight each eligible site-cycle D and separately median D
Number of site-cycles D>0, D<0, D==0 including zeros
Physical-site leave-one-out min-max of camera-equal D, NOT a confidence interval
Each year/cycle number eligible, distinct sites, source records by focal and comparison, sign counts and camera-equal D

All-site-cycle STRICT complete 2taxon×2season×2night cells-positive triple log-odds contrast (ln [ (F_fN/F_fD)/(C_fN/C_fD) ] minus same ratio in rising), undefined without eight positive source cells; NO pseudocounts
Report all four pairs including unavailable/sparse, no after-result substitution

null_and_limits: A matched site-cycle merely recording both species is outcome-conditioned co-detection selection and cannot support unbiased all-site predator/prey encounter rates.

q/physical station hourly uptime or independently sampled true animal passage is unavailable. Differential image detection by animal body size and distance can distort photo-time D even at same camera.
Two species recorded at similar times does not prove physical interaction, active hunting, avoidance, diet or competition.
Not all photos identify independent individual animals. No event-independent binomial p-value, individual-population CI or causal inference.
186 original sites are within ONE sampled Serengeti landscape, not 186 independent climates or regions.
Year cycles are repeated station measurements and too few for climate mechanism mediation.
All raw station identifiers, precise coordinates and photo timestamps stay inside CI and MUST NOT leave source; aggregate species-pair receipts only.
Source event time transform and first original photo v0 result are immutable, no rescue by altering species date bins after outcomes.
result_logic: If fewer than two independent physical cameras for a pair with all four detected site×branch margins, report DEFINITIONALLY UNINFORMATIVE rather than claim site-general transfer. If strict complete cells absent, triple log-odds undefined and reported, not smoothed.
